cards.name: Sealed Glyphs Dragon

effects.printed_clause: 2+ Level 7 monsters; alternatively Xyz Summon using 1 monster you control and 1 face-up Spell/Trap your opponent owns, transferring materials.
effects.lua_implementation: A field Summon procedure, subgroup legality check, material transfer, SetMaterial, Duel.Overlay, and SUMMON_TYPE_XYZ implement the alternative Xyz Summon exactly; uniqueness of the material combination does not make it an engine gap.

official_references.matched_structure: Alternative Xyz Summon with material transfer.

effects.printed_clause: If Xyz Summoned this way, you cannot Normal or Special Summon for the rest of the turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The alternative procedure operation registers player-targeted EFFECT_CANNOT_SUMMON and EFFECT_CANNOT_SPECIAL_SUMMON through PHASE_END; normal Xyz procedure does not.

effects.printed_clause: Once per turn Quick Effect: detach 1; unaffected by opponent Spell/Trap Cards and effects until end turn.
effects.lua_implementation: SOPT Quick Effect detaches one as cost and registers single-card immunity to opponent-owned Spell/Trap effects through PHASE_END.

official_references.matched_structure: Opponent-only protection filter and end-turn reset structure.

cards.audit_note: Adversarial completion review: effect 1 pass. Prior labels were not treated as evidence.
